claim_scope: For the ternary squarefree Thue word fixed by 0->012,1->02,2->1, at every dyadic length n=2^j with j>=2, the 2-binomial complexity is exactly 3n and the first 3n factors are pairwise distinguishable by their N1,M1,N0,M0 statistics.
integrity: Self-contained proof with a standalone finite-instance diagnostic; computation is not used as a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Dyadic lengths n=2^j for j>=2 only; no formula asserted at arbitrary n.
Independent validation and exhaustive priority assessment are not claimed.
The proof relies on the established factor-complexity formula of the binary Thue-Morse word and its ternary transition coding.
title: Dyadic 2-binomial rigidity of the ternary squarefree Thue word
